name: multi-account-mcp
description: Local-first, read-only MCP for multiple Gmail and Google Drive accounts.

interface.shortDescription: Read multiple Gmail and Drive accounts.
interface.longDescription: A local-first, read-only MCP for searching and reading multiple explicitly selected Gmail and Google Drive accounts. DPoP-bound refresh tokens, per-account DPoP private keys, and OAuth client credentials stay in the operating-system credential vault; access and ID tokens remain process-local.
defaultPrompt: List the Google account aliases I can choose from.
Find a file in the Google Drive account aliases I name.
Search the Gmail account aliases I name when Gmail tools are enabled.
